_meta.resolver_strategy: Crossref-first search by author+keywords+year (no pre-typed DOIs). Strict verification required: first-author surname must match the content_strategy.md hint, year must fall in ±1 year window, journal family must match, and title must share >=25% of content words with the query keywords. Unresolved entries were retried with a wider query (no journal filter). DOIs confirmed to match are then sent to Unpaywall -> PMC OA fallback.
important_caveats: These references are PRE-RESOLVED for posts that have not yet been drafted. The slug names are researcher guesses; frontend-writer may rename when drafting.

Two entries were demoted during audit (nutrition_low_fat_myth #3 and rehab_low_back_movement_new #2) because Crossref returned semantically adjacent but wrong papers. Consider these references as 'needs alternative source'.
Three entries could not be resolved at all (status=unresolved, no DOI) — researcher can retry once content_strategy.md adds richer citation hints.
One reference (Wilson 2012 concurrent training) appears in two slugs and correctly resolves to the same DOI both times.
_meta.frontend_writer_instructions: When drafting Posts 22-41, prefer citations from status='ok' entries (verified + OA). For status='doi_only' entries you can still cite by DOI — the paper exists and is correct, just not open-access for us to download. For status='unresolved' entries, you'll need to pick a different reference; flag them back to researcher via SendMessage with the post slug and ref_idx.
_meta.backend_writer_instructions: This JSON is NOT yet a download manifest. Once frontend-writer drafts the posts and assigns final slug names, promote the status='ok' entries into training_pdf_urls.json (or a similar manifest) and run the Task #3 downloader.
